## Fable review — full diff, then delta

An isolated reviewer subagent (model `fable`, read-only) was given the diff and card #31099, not the author's conclusions, and checked every sentence against `seed-loader.ts`, `app-plugin.ts`, `protocol-publish-batch.ts`, `domains/packages.ts`, `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` and `sys-seed-landed-key.object.ts`.

**Round 1 (diff `5f00374492..ca38274b`): PASS with should-fix.**

1. should-fix — the new `mode` docstring paragraph named the loads that keep the record but not the condition that the composition registers `sys_seed_landed_key` (`openLandedKeyLedger` answers none without it), and said "every row" where only a keyed row is recorded. **Applied in 89162ffb.**
2. nit — the `insert` comment "(a row the database refuses fails)" is true but did not say the rest still land. **Applied in 89162ffb:** "is that row's error".
3. nit — the marketplace's fallback `seed-replayer` keeps no record; the sentence is scoped to "the loads AppPlugin runs", so not false. No change.

Checked true: `replace` and `insert` are bare inserts and nothing in the loader deletes; the record is kept only for `upsert`/`ignore`; a withdrawn row is not re-inserted under `honour`; a never-recorded key still lands; `reseed` inserts every missing row; the three honouring call sites and the three no-record constructions; the CLI note and its test pin match; the changeset carries both line-initial declarations; no tracker number in `.describe()`; the regenerated references match the `.describe()`.

**Round 2 (delta `ca38274b..89162ffb`): PASS.** One cosmetic nit (a short line in the reflowed paragraph), left as is.

Head after the merge of `origin/main`: 68060aa22b (the merge brings no seed, spec or `diff.ts` change).

<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **4** documentable anchor(s).

**4** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx`  _(via SeedSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`  _(via os diff (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/diff.ts))_
- `content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx`  _(via os diff (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/diff.ts))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/schema.mdx`  _(via os diff (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/diff.ts))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **226** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **180** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 98583cd692c6a67891617529d2f7aec4963859b8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a295035a7cc5972c3ef13ccfb7f1ddfb61914496` — the merge of head `68060aa22bf15b378c1b8adb2fca27cb844054ef` into base `98583cd692c6a67891617529d2f7aec4963859b8`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a295035a7cc5972c3ef13ccfb7f1ddfb61914496 && git checkout a295035a7cc5972c3ef13ccfb7f1ddfb61914496
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 98583cd692c6a67891617529d2f7aec4963859b8 68060aa22bf15b378c1b8adb2fca27cb844054ef && git checkout -B drift-repro 98583cd692c6a67891617529d2f7aec4963859b8 && git merge --no-ff 68060aa22bf15b378c1b8adb2fca27cb844054ef

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 98583cd692c6a67891617529d2f7aec4963859b8
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 98583cd692c6a67891617529d2f7aec4963859b8` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `68060aa22bf15b378c1b8adb2fca27cb844054ef`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts + packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts, packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/package-upgrade-plan.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/plugin.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/diff.ts, packages/cli/test/diff-upgrade-plan.test.ts, the 4 regenerated reference pages, the changeset

### ① Derived judgments

Accept set and public surface: **unchanged**. `SeedMode` keeps its five members in order; `mode: SeedMode.default('ignore')` is untouched; no field of `SeedSchema` is added, removed, renamed or re-typed. Only enum member comments, the `mode` JSDoc, the `mode` `.describe()`, one CLI note string and its test pin move. Ruling 6631016988 on #30081 (`ignore` is the default, create-only) is kept in the `.describe()` lead and the docstring.

Every changed sentence checked against `main`:
- `insert` comment — TRUE: `SeedLoaderService.writeRecord` case `'insert'` calls `engine.insert` without consulting `existing`; `decideWriteAction` answers `insert` for `insert`, `replace` and default; a refused row is counted and pushed to the load's errors on both the sequential and batched paths while the rest land.
- `replace` comment — TRUE: the `'replace'` arm is a bare `engine.insert` ("caller should have cleared the table"); nothing in the loader deletes.
- Docstring landed-keys paragraph — TRUE: `seedLoaderOptionsFor(ctx, 'honour')` on the single-tenant inline seed, the `seed-replayer` replay (honour unless `reseed === true`) and the `metadata:reloaded` hot reload; `openLandedKeyLedger` keeps no ledger without `landedKeys`, on a dry run, without an organization, or when `sys_seed_landed_key` is not registered; recorded keys read only for `upsert`/`ignore`; only keyed rows; a never-recorded key still lands.
- "A seed publish and a package install or upgrade keep no record" — TRUE: the publish batch and `applyPublishedSeeds` construct the loader without `landedKeys`; `os package install` → marketplace install-local seeds through `runInlineSeed` without `landedKeys` (also its reseed and heal).
- Re-seed door `seed-replayer(organizationId, { reseed: true })` — TRUE: honour off ⇒ `isWithdrawnRow` false; keys still recorded.
- `.describe()` — TRUE, a compression of the docstring; no `#NNNN`.
- CLI note "a replay deletes nothing and inserts these again, so rows already in the table stay" — TRUE and reachable (`seedModeOverwritesMatchedRows` is `upsert || update` only); the test pin carries the identical string.
- The 4 regenerated reference pages equal the new `.describe()` word for word (MDX brace escaping aside).

No finding in ①.

### ② Semver level

Consistent: `@objectstack/spec` patch (comments, JSDoc, `.describe()`), `@objectstack/cli` patch (one message and its pin). `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right and sit line-initial in the changeset and the PR body. No finding.

### ③ Boundary flags

Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; `open_questions: []`. Two dev notes, both should-fix, outside this card, non-blocking — the seat files a card for each:
1. `os diff` prints no note for mode `insert`, whose loader arm is identical to `replace`'s, so one behaviour reads two ways in the same output (CLI lane).
2. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` still quotes the old `replace` text as a declared ≠ implemented posture and cites `seed.zod.ts#SeedMode` for it; after this PR the source no longer holds that text (QA checklist).
Read, not flagged: the marketplace's own fallback `buildSeedReplayer` builds its loader without `landedKeys`; the new text scopes the rule to the loads AppPlugin runs, so it is not contradicted. No card.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts` holds against the code it cites and the card's acceptance (item 1): the `insert`/`replace` comments describe the `writeRecord` arms as they are; the docstring and `.describe()` gain the landed-keys exception (three AppPlugin loads, the `sys_seed_landed_key` condition, `ignore`/`upsert` only, keyed rows only, never-recorded keys still land, publish and package install keep no record) and the re-seed door, each clause traceable to code. The history string stays historical, as the card allows. The author-side Fable round's two should-fixes are in the head. No finding.
